race.comment: DIVER DAN (3) is the one to beat after a very genuine third at this track, beaten half a length by Pretey Royal after giving a bold sight over 1600m. His previous fourth to Alot Of Desire was also sound, so he brings the most reliable recent form among the main chances. RAPTOR NOT (12) is lightly raced and improved sharply at Northam, finishing fifth and beaten just under three lengths after picking up nicely in the straight, which gives her clear upside third-up. IL BELLO BEALS (1) was beaten just over three lengths by Jewel Of Zavala last start, though his long maiden record keeps him short of being a clear top pick. MAGNIFICENT MIA (8) has been well beaten at her past two, but the 3kg claim and inside draw give her some scope to rebound into a minor role if she finds her earlier place form. AUBURN (4) is next best in this suitable race.
